metadata.title: Fractional illumination and the optimal exponential rate in Hadwiger's covering conjecture
metadata.abstract: We show that the fractional illumination number of every convex body in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is at most $2^d$, with equality exactly for parallelotopes. We also prove that every such body can be covered by at most $2^d(d\log d+d\log\log d+O(d))$ smaller positive homothetic copies as $d\to\infty$, establishing the optimal exponential rate in Hadwiger's covering conjecture. The proofs use a covering measure obtained by minimizing an overlap energy and a greedy covering argument on a finite net.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明任意 d 维凸体的分数照明数≤2^d，等号恰为平行多面体，并给出 2^d 乘 dlogd 量级的较小同位体覆盖数。
analysis.breakthrough: 实现 Hadwiger 覆盖猜想的最优指数增长率。
analysis.limitations: 分数照明数 2^d 不等于整数覆盖数已达 2^d；额外多项式因子仍存在。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
